title: fix: backfill community app screenshots
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds 14 screenshot URLs to the app catalog.
- Leaves Open WebUI without a screenshot because its app screen requires authorization.
- Validated all 849 catalog entries, formatting, and a structural comparison confirming that only 14 screenshot fields change.

gist.headline: Fourteen apps get portraits
gist.blurb: Fourteen community apps finally got their little catalog headshots. Open WebUI remains tastefully behind its authorization gate, where it belongs.
gist.summary: Backfilled screenshot URLs for 14 app catalog entries after validating all 849 entries, while leaving Open WebUI unchanged because its screen requires authorization.
gist.impact: Visitors browsing the community app catalog will now see screenshots for 14 more apps, making those projects easier to recognize before opening them.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny gallery curator hanging 14 miniature pixel-art app screenshots along a cozy garden catalog wall, with code-plants and flowers around the display. Include one politely locked, unlabeled frame for Open WebUI to represent its authorization-only screen without making it feel excluded.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny curator beret, carefully hanging a row of 14 miniature app screenshot frames on a lime green (#ecf874) garden catalog wall; code-plants and pastel flowers grow beneath, while one small frame has a gentle pixel lock icon. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
